instructions: A storyteller at a campfire, late at night. Warm, low and unhurried, with the weight of someone who already knows how this ends. Never theatrical, never breathless. Leave a little air around the words.

chapters.text: The court is seated, and the cards are dealt. Take up your own, and let no one else see it.
Speak now, all of you at once. Approve, or refuse.
The court consents. The company departs.
Four refusals stand against you. Refuse once more and Mordred takes the realm without lifting a blade.
The company rides. Play your hand, and be careful who is watching.
The quest holds. Arthur's banner still stands.
Sabotage. There was a traitor among them.
The Lady of the Lake rises. One loyalty will be known, and only to the one who asks.
Three quests have held. Yet the Assassin waits in the dark, and needs only a name.
Merlin was never found. Camelot stands, and the light holds.
Three quests broken. The realm falls to Mordred.
The blade finds Merlin after all. Everything won is undone.
Five times you refused one another. Camelot tears itself apart, and evil needs to do nothing at all.
